query: SELECT pc.mes, pc.ano, SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_lancamentos FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN periodo_custo pc ON lc.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE (pc.mes = 4 AND pc.ano = 2026) OR (pc.mes = 3 AND pc.ano = 2026) OR (pc.mes = 2 AND pc.ano = 2026) GROUP BY pc.mes, pc.ano ORDER BY pc.ano, pc.mes;
